newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian plane not hijacked, part of drill-officials.
newsitem.headline: Indian plane not hijacked, part of drill-officials.

text.p: Indian officials said on Thursday that a plane which was earlier reported to have been hijacked was involved in a mock exercise to test security systems.
"As far as I know, it is a mock exercise to test the systems," a government spokesman told reporters.
"I would say it is a drill," a senior Indian Airlines official told Reuters by telephone. "Sometimes we have this security."
Earlier, airline officials and police said the Alliance Air flight 421A was hijacked after taking off from New Delhi on its ways to the northern city of Jammu.
"It was just an exercise. The plane has landed in Delhi," an airport official said.
